vulnerabilities.title: Apple Multiple Products
vulnerabilities.name: Apple Multiple Products Improper Authentication Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: Apple iOS, iPadOS, macOS, Safari, tvOS and watchOS 10.5 contain an improper authentication vulnerability which could allow an attacker with arbitrary read and write capability to bypass pointer authentication.

vulnerabilities.title: WordPress WordPress Core
vulnerabilities.name: WordPress WordPress Core Time-of-check Time-of-use (TOCTOU) Race Condition Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: WordPress WordPress Core contains a time-of-check time-of-use (TOCTOU) race condition vulnerability that could allow unauthenticated attackers to execute code on the server during the upgrade window. This is due to predictable, web-accessible staging paths used during full-package core upgrades.
